questions.question: A boat can travel 104 km downstream in 8 hours. If the speed of the stream is 2 km/h, then find in what time will it be able to cover 13 km upstream?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Downstream speed = 104 ÷ 8 = 13 km/h.

Upstream speed = Downstream speed − (2 × Speed of stream)

Upstream speed = 13 − (2 × 2) = 9 km/h.

Time for 13 km upstream = 13 ÷ 9 = 1 4/9 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 1 4/9 hours.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Downstream distance = 104 km

Downstream time = 8 hours

Speed of stream (v) = 2 km/h

Upstream distance = 13 km

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Downstream speed (D) = u + v

Upstream speed (U) = u − v

Where u = speed of boat in still water and v = speed of stream.

 
• 
 

 Downstream: 104 km / 8 hrs = 13 km/h
 
• 
 

 Upstream: Distance = 13 km
 Result: Time = 13 ÷ 9 = 1 4/9 hours

**Calculations:**

⇒ Downstream speed (D) = 104 ÷ 8 = 13 km/h

⇒ u + v = 13

⇒ u + 2 = 13

⇒ u = 13 − 2 = 11 km/h

⇒ Upstream speed (U) = u − v = 11 − 2 = 9 km/h

⇒ Time taken = Distance ÷ Upstream speed

⇒ Time taken = 13 ÷ 9 = 1 4/9 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 1 4/9 hours.**

**__Additional Information__**

Downstream and Upstream Speed

Downstream speed (D) = Speed of boat in still water (u) + Speed of stream (v). Upstream speed (U) = u − v.

Speed of Boat in Still Water

The speed of the boat in still water can be calculated as u = (D + U) ÷ 2.

Speed of the Stream

The speed of the current or stream can be calculated as v = (D − U) ÷ 2.</p

questions.question: If a + b + c = 10 and a² + b² + c² = 48, then the value of ab + bc + ca is _______.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a + b + c = 10 and a2 + b2 + c2 = 4

**Concept Used:**

(a + b + c)² = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Using the formula (a + b + c)2 we get,

⇒ (a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca 

⇒ (10)2 = 48+ 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 100 – 48 = 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ ab + bc + ca = (52)/(2) = 26

**Therefore, the value of ab + bc + ca is 26.**

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 10 days, while A and B together can complete it in 2(1)/(2) days. How long will B alone take to complete the work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A and B together can complete the work in 2(1)/(2) days.

A alone can complete the work in 10 days.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Work done by A each day = (1)/(10)

⇒ According to the question,

⇒ (1)/(10)+(1)/(B)=(2)/(5)

⇒ (1)/(B)=(2)/(5)-(1)/(10)

⇒ (1)/(B)=(4-1)/(10) = (3)/(10)

⇒ B = (10)/(3)

**Therefore, B alone will take (10)/(3) days to complete the work.**

questions.question: The number of persons raise by 20% to 30,942 in a year. What was the population originally a year ago?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Increase in 1 year = 20%

Population after increase = 30,942

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the population a year ago be x.

⇒ So, x + 20% of x = 30942

⇒ x + (20)/(100) × x = 30942

⇒ x + (x)/(5) = 30942

⇒ (5x+x)/(5) = 30942

⇒ x = (30942times 5)/(6) = 5157 × 5 = 25785

**Therefore, the population originally a year ago was 25785.**

questions.question: Bhavani spent 15% of her monthly income on kid’s education and 20% on food. 40% of the remaining she spent on sports and 30% on transport. She is left with an amount of Rs. 10,257 after all these expenditures. What is Bhavani’s monthly income?
questions.solution:

Bhavani spent on kid's education = 15%

Bhavani spent on food = 20%

Remaining percentage spent on sports = 40%

Remaining percentage spent on transport = 30%

Amount left after all expenditures = Rs 10,257

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the monthly income of Bhavani be x.

⇒ Income spent on education = (15)/(100)x

⇒ Income spent on food = (20)/(100)x

⇒ Remaining Income = x – ( (15)/(100)x + (20)/(100)x) = x – (35)/(100)x = (65)/(100)x

⇒ Income spent on sports = (40)/(100) × (65)/(100)x = (26)/(100)x

⇒ Income spent on transport = (30)/(100)x × (65)/(100)x = (195)/(1000)x

⇒ Amount left = 10257

⇒ 10257 = x – ((15)/(100)x + (20)/(100)x + (26)/(100)x + (195)/(1000)x) 

⇒ 10257 = x – ((805)/(1000)x)

⇒ 10257 = (195)/(1000)x

⇒ x = (10257times 1000)/(195) = 52,600

**Therefore, Bhavani's monthly income is Rs. 52,600.**

questions.question: 12 men or 20 boys can finish a work in 10 days. What part of the same work will be done by 4 men and 4 boys in 4 days?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

12 men or 20 boys can finish a work in 10 days

**FORMULA USED:**

Efficiency = Total work done/No. of days 

**CALCULATION:**

Here, we have

12 men or 20 boys can finish a work in 10 days 

So, 12 M = 20 B 

⇒ M/B = 5/3 

Now, 12 men worked for 10 days 

Total work done = 12 × 5 ×10 = 600 unit 

Now, 4 men and 4 boys will work in 4 days 

⇒ [ (4 × 5) + (4 × 3) ] × 4

⇒ 128

The part of the same work done = 128/600 = 16/75

**Hence, 16/75 of the same work is done by 4 men and 4 boys .**

questions.question: The areas of two similar triangles ABC and PQR are 64cm² and 144cm², respectively. If the greatest side of the smaller ΔABC is 24 cm, then what is the greatest side of the bigger ΔPQR?

Greatest side of the smaller triangle ABC = 24cm

Ratio of the area of triangles = (ratio of sides of the triangles)²

⇒ 64/144 = (24/x)²

⇒ 8/12 = 24/x

⇒ x = 36 cm 

**∴ The greatest side of the bigger ΔPQR is 36 cm.**

questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 1224 and their HCF is 68. The number of co-prime pairs satisfying the above condition is:
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

The sum of two numbers is 1224 and their HCF is 68 

**CONCEPT USED:**

H.C.F = H.C.F of two numbers is the highest possible number that divides both numbers completely

**CALCULATION:**

Let the two numbers be x and y respectively

It is given that the sum of the two numbers is 1224, therefore

x + y = 1224 

Also, 68 is their HCF, thus both numbers must be divisible by 68 

So, let x = 68a and y = 68b , ( a + b) then 

68a + 68b = 1224 

⇒ 68 ( a + b ) = 1224 

⇒ ( a + b) = 18

Therefore, the possible pair of values of x and y which are coprime pairs are (1,17), (5,13), and (7,11) 

Thus, the required numbers are ( 1,17), ( 5,13), ( 7,11) 

**Hence, the number of possible pairs is 3.**

questions.question: The number of factors of 196 which are divisible by 4 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Prime factorization of **196** = 2² × 7².

To be divisible by **4** (2²), the factor must contain 2² as a component.

Factors divisible by 4 = (Number of ways to choose 2²) × (Number of ways to choose powers of 7).

Factors = 1 × (2 + 1) = 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Number = **196**.

**Formula:** If N = ap × bq × cr, total factors = (p+1)(q+1)(r+1).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96da2b121119b326356e3008c77d142715469e3df92d841a4558ea204713f3ee.png] 

⇒ Prime factorization of 196 = 2 × 2 × 7 × 7 = 2² × 7².

⇒ All factors of 196 are: 1, 2, 4, 7, 14, 28, 49, 98, 196.

⇒ Factors divisible by 4 are: 4, 28, and 196.

⇒ Total count = 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Number of Factors

For a number N = p₁a × p₂b, the total number of factors is (a + 1)(b + 1).

Sum of Factors

Sum = [ (p₁a⁺¹ − 1) / (p₁ − 1) ] × [ (p₂b⁺¹ − 1) / (p₂ − 1) ].

Even and Odd Factors

To find even factors of 2a × 3b, we use (a) × (b + 1). For odd factors, we use only (b + 1).</p

questions.question: The value of (1+ cot A – cosec A)(1 + tan A + sec A) – 1 is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(1+ cot A – cosec A)(1 + tan A + sec A) – 1 

**Concept used:**

Cotθ = Cosθ/Sinθ 

Cosecθ = 1/Sinθ

tanθ = sinθ/cosθ

secθ = 1/cosθ

Sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

(a + b)(a - b) = (a - b)² 

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

[(1 + cot A – cosec A)(1 + tan A + sec A)] - 1

⇒ [(1 + (CosA/SinA) – 1/SinA)(1 + (SinA/CosA) + 1/CosA)] - 1

⇒ [(SinA + CosA – 1)/SinA)(CosA + SinA + 1)/CosA)] - 1

⇒ [(Sin A + CosA)² – 1²)/CosASinA] - 1

⇒ [(Sin²A + Cos²A + 2CosASinA – 1)/CosASinA] - 1

⇒ [(1 + 2CosASinA – 1)/CosASinA] - 1

⇒ [2CosASinA/CosASinA] - 1

⇒ [2] - 1 = 1

**∴ The value of the given equation is 1.**

questions.question: The ratio of two numbers is 4 : 5, and their HCF is 3. What is their LCM?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of two numbers is 4 : 5.

HCF is 3

**Concept used:**

LCM × HCF = Product of two numbers

If there are two numbers namely a and b, and their HCF is x 

Then the numbers are ax and bx (provided that a and b are co-prime numbers)

Co-prime numbers = Those numbers that have only one common factor, namely 1 

**Calculations:**

Here, we have numbers in the ratio 4 : 5 and their HCF is 3 

As, the numbers are in co-prime ( as 4 and 5 don't have any common factor)

So, the number becomes 4 × 3 = 12 and 5 × 3 = 15 

As, we know 

L.C.M × H.C.F = Product of two numbers 

L.C.M × 3 = 12 × 15 

L.C.M = 60

**∴ LCM of these two numbers is 60.**

questions.question: If two tangents to a circle of radius 3 cm are inclined to each other at angle of 60°, then the length of each tangent is:

Two tangents to a circle of radius 3 cm are inclined to each other at angle of 60°

**Concept used:**

An external point's tangents to a circle are equal.

SSS congruency criterion

Tan 30° trignometric ratio = 1/√3

**Calculations:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f96235eea3435c132300b1f21278d8243aa56a6de9776b43ef3a4629de76e9b.png] 

Let AP and CP be the tangents drawn to a circle

According to the question,

∠CPA = 60°

So, AP = CP

In triangle PAO and triangle PCO,

⇒ AP = CP

⇒ AO = CO = radius of circle

⇒ PO = PO = common side

Triangle PAO and triangle PCO are similar, by SSS criterion, 

At the point of contact the radius of a circle is perpendicular to the tangent

So, ∠PAO = ∠PCO = 90°

Since AO = CO = radius

⇒ ∠PAO = ∠PCO

⇒ ∠CPA = ∠OPA + ∠OPC

⇒ 2∠OPA = 60°

⇒ ∠OPA = 60°/2

⇒ ∠OPA = 30°

In triangle PAO,

PAO is a right triangle with A at right angle.

⇒ tan 30° = AO/PA

⇒ 1/√3 = 3/AP

⇒ AP = 3√3 cm

**∴ The length of each tangent is 3√3 cm.**

⇒ P% = 0.375 × 100 = 37.5%
